requirements.rule: Art. 9 (Sez. IV Tit. III): the holidays of letters b and c in a sickness or a work injury reach 100% (sickness_rules.holiday and insured_absence.injury.holiday). Not calculated: the holiday top-up during pregnancy and puerperium, the patron saint substitute and 29 June, a letter b holiday in Rome only, outside the national calendar.
requirements.remediation: Top up pregnancy and puerperium holidays, the substitute patron holiday and Rome-only 29 June when the applicable local facts are stated.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, PAR (Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 5, renewal of 22 November 2025 p. 33): the settore siderurgico (EmployerProfile.subsector steel) accrues 124 hours in place of 104, and the turnisti on 15 or more weekly shifts including the night shift (Employment.qualifying_shifts) 8 hours more. The further 4 hours from 2027 at 18 or more weekly shifts and 4 more from 2028 at 21 for the non siderurgico workers are permit extra_hours on Employment.weekly_shifts. Not modelled: the 8 hours of the siderurgico turnisti, paid with the 13th; and the hour of the sottosettori of the accordo of 16 July 1979 for the workers in service at 31 December 2012.
requirements.remediation: Pay the 8 hours of the siderurgico turnisti with the 13th and add the fact of the 1979 sottosettori for the workers in service at 31 December 2012, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: MULTI-WEEK SCHEDULE AND SHIFT NIGHT-HOLIDAY: the premiums of the orario plurisettimanale of Art. 5 as renewed on 22 November 2025 are the bands OT_PLURI (15%), OT_PLURI_SABATO (25%) and, for sudden needs, OT_PLURI_IMPROVVISO (20%) and OT_PLURI_IMPROVVISO_SABATO (30%), premium only. Not modelled: their rise 'a partire dalla 81esima ora' ('elevate nella misura onnicomprensiva dell'8%'), which needs the hours of the schedule worked in the year, and the night-holiday rates of the shift workers of Art. 7 rows h) and i) (60%, 35%; 65%, 40% from 22 to 6). The shift column of the overtime of Art. 7 is: OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI, OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI_EXTRA and OT_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO_TURNI for an event with in_periodic_shift.
requirements.remediation: Add the hours of the multi-week schedule worked in the year to pay the 8% from the 81st hour, and the night-holiday rates of the shift workers, then resolve this limitation.
